title: Manabrew Client Errors
description: Grouped, privacy-filtered client errors. Exact signatures are build-sensitive; counts are received reports, not affected people.

list.label: Smoke tests

panels.title: Received error reports
panels.description: All matching stored reports in the selected time range, before the group-table limit. Client deduplication and delivery limits apply.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({app="manabrew-client",environment=~"${environment:regex}",source=~"${source:regex}"} | json | __error__="" | kind="exception" | type=~"${error_type:regex}" | context_platform=~"${platform:regex}" | context_engine=~"${engine:regex}" | context_signature!="" | value!~${smoke:json} | label_format browser_original=`{{ __line__ }}` | line_format "{{ .context_version }}" |= ${version:json} | line_format "{{ .value }}" |= ${message:json} | line_format "{{ .browser_original }}" | drop browser_original | keep source [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Exact error groups
panels.description: Distinct exact signatures matching the filters, before the table limit. Signatures can differ across builds and browser evaluations.

targets.expr: count(sum by (context_signature) (count_over_time({app="manabrew-client",environment=~"${environment:regex}",source=~"${source:regex}"} | json | __error__="" | kind="exception" | type=~"${error_type:regex}" | context_platform=~"${platform:regex}" | context_engine=~"${engine:regex}" | context_signature!="" | value!~${smoke:json} | label_format browser_original=`{{ __line__ }}` | line_format "{{ .context_version }}" |= ${version:json} | line_format "{{ .value }}" |= ${message:json} | line_format "{{ .browser_original }}" | drop browser_original | keep context_signature [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Reports by error type
panels.description: Counts of stored reports per interval. Select a time range or error type to narrow the groups below.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (count_over_time({app="manabrew-client",environment=~"${environment:regex}",source=~"${source:regex}"} | json | __error__="" | kind="exception" | type=~"${error_type:regex}" | context_platform=~"${platform:regex}" | context_engine=~"${engine:regex}" | context_signature!="" | value!~${smoke:json} | label_format browser_original=`{{ __line__ }}` | line_format "{{ .context_version }}" |= ${version:json} | line_format "{{ .value }}" |= ${message:json} | line_format "{{ .browser_original }}" | drop browser_original | keep type [$__auto]))

panels.title: Error groups · up to $groups
panels.description: One row per exact signature, combining matching platforms and releases. Type/message/location/release/platform describe a most-recent matching report. Rank groups by chooses the globally most frequent or most recent groups before the limit; column headers sort only the loaded rows. Click a message or signature for all matching occurrences.

options.content:
Choose **Rank groups by** to select the most frequent or most recent groups across the full filtered range. Header sorting and table pagination affect only the loaded groups. Raise **Group limit** or narrow the filters when the group total exceeds the limit.

Click a message to browse occurrences, stacks, causes and diagnostic context. Release and message searches are literal and case-sensitive. Smoke tests are hidden by default. Counts represent received reports, not unique people or every thrown exception. Exact signatures may split across releases; retained history is limited to 30 days. Loki metric aggregation is bounded at 10,000 series; narrow the time range or filters if that backend limit is reached.
